critical_code_review_comments: property_export.build_zip downloads every original object serially via storage.download in an async loop. For a large property (e.g., 100 photos of 5MB each) this can take tens of seconds and holds the whole ZIP in memory (buf = BytesIO). Two future improvements when 'Exportar Propiedad' ships: (a) parallelize downloads with asyncio.gather(bounded by a Semaphore, e.g., 6 in-flight) to cut wall time; (b) stream the response using StreamingResponse + zipstream so the client starts receiving bytes early and RAM stays flat.

routes_files.export_photos loads the whole ZIP into a Response(content=...) which sends Content-Length correctly but blocks the event loop worker while zipping. For a future ZIP with documents+videos this can be 1GB+; move to StreamingResponse to avoid worker starvation.

property_export.photo_entries silently falls back to 'foto-{idx}.jpg' when original_name and stored_name are both missing. Given the RULE 'VERA nunca modifica el archivo original', this fallback should be exceptional but is currently unlogged — consider a warning log when it triggers so we can spot corrupted metadata.

routes_files._content_disposition strips non-ascii from the ascii fallback (encode('ascii','ignore')). If the original name is 'Ñoquis.png' the ascii fallback becomes 'oquis.png'. The RFC 5987 filename* preserves the full name, so modern browsers get it right, but older clients get a slightly wrong ascii name. Consider slugifying (transliteration) instead of hard-stripping to keep the ascii fallback readable.

routes_files.download_image / export_photos have no auth check (endpoints are open by design today). Same backlog item noted in test_credentials.md — worth flagging that both new endpoints inherit the open-service_role posture; harden with JWT verification when auth is enforced.

PropertyWorkspace.triggerBrowserDownload uses <a href> + click(); since the backend sets Content-Disposition=attachment the browser saves the file even without an 'a.download' attribute. Works today; if a future export endpoint returns text/html or a MIME the browser can render (e.g., PDFs), consider adding a.download to force save (the browser's PDF viewer will preempt otherwise).

PhotosSection: the per-photo download button appears only on hover (opacity 0 → 1 on .vera-photo:hover). Keyboard-only users can still Tab to it, but there is no visible focus outline distinct from the container. Consider adding :focus-visible styling so the button is discoverable without a mouse.

PhotosSection: onDownloadAllPhotos is disabled (undefined) when photos.length === 0. Correct — but the flash of the empty gallery state right after opening a property while images are loading via useWorkspaceGallery might briefly hide the button; not a bug, just a UX note if perceived latency is reported.
